```yaml
name: Claude PR Critique

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  claude-critique:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run linting and type checking in web
        run: |
          cd web
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck

      - name: Run tests in web
        run: |
          cd web
          npm test

      - name: Run linting in apps
        run: |
          cd apps
          npm run lint

      - name: Run type checking in apps
        run: |
          cd apps
          npm run typecheck

      - name: Run linting in electron
        run: |
          cd electron
          npm run lint

      - name: Run type checking in electron
        run: |
          cd electron
          npm run typecheck

      - name: Run tests in electron
        run: |
          cd electron
          npm test

      - name: Request Claude critique
        uses: anc95/ChatGPT-CodeReview@main
        with:
          api_key: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
